Pass 1, gated by the address value of global unk_602000 (0x602000) being a set bitmask in the flags dword at this+0x60, regenerates engine sound wave tables via EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator and then, when the format byte at this+0x116 equals 3, remaps each pixel's three RGB bytes at the buffer (this+0x104) through a lookup table (this+0x138). Pass 2, gated by flags bit 3 (0x8) at this+0x60 and the same format value 3, computes per-channel shift amounts as 8 minus the amplitude bytes at this+0x150/0x151/0x152, clamps oversize shifts to 0, and right-shifts each pixel's R/G/B channels by those amounts. Both passes iterate the pixel count WORD at this+0x108.

Pass 1 gate: the address value of unk_602000 (0x602000) is used as a bitmask; when it has any bits set against the flags dword at this+0x60 the pass runs.
Regenerate the engine sound wave tables via EngineSoundWaveTableGenerator, which also supplies the lookup table pointer consumed by the remap pass.
Pass 1 remap runs only when the format byte at this+0x116 equals 3.
Iterate the pixel count WORD at this+0x108; for each pixel remap three consecutive bytes at the buffer pointed to by this+0x104 through the lookup table at this+0x138.
Rewrite the third channel (B) byte of the first pixel at *(this+0x104)+2 with the lookup-table result.
Pass 2 gate: the flags byte at this+0x60 has bit 3 (0x8) set and the format byte at this+0x116 equals 3.
Compute per-channel right-shift amounts as 8 minus the amplitude bytes at this+0x150 (red), this+0x151 (green) and this+0x152 (blue).
Clamp each computed shift amount to 0 when the 8-minus-amplitude value exceeds 8.
Iterate the pixel count WORD at this+0x108; right-shift each pixel's R/G/B channels at the buffer pointed to by this+0x104 by the respective clamped shift amounts.
Legacy ABI label Texture_Image_Color_Transform corroborates the texture color-transformation role.

functions.name: PNGRowTransformPipeline
functions.summary: Applies the PNG row transform pipeline to one decoded image row of a PNG info context struct (a1). Guarding on two transform-flag bytes in the context, it sequentially invokes the decompression, palette, expansion, dithering, background, unpacking, swapping, and inversion subroutines, passing the row buffer, rowbytes (buffer pointer value + 1), and context parameters as arguments. Two fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp paths protect against a NULL row buffer at entry and zero rowbytes output after PixelFormatConverter. Returns void.

operations.description: Guard: row buffer pointer (this+0xDC) must be non-null. If null, fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp with string 'NULL row buffer' (global:0x005AF474). Single caller is sub_511B7C.
Guard: PNG transform flags upper byte (this+0x61) bit 0x10 set selects the deinterlace/expand branch.
Guard: PNG color type (this+0xF8) == 3 (indexed/palette) selects sub_512E1A path: call with buffer, rowbytes+1, this+0x104, this+0x15C, and this+0x10A.
Guard: when color type != 3 and the row width word (this+0x10A) is non-zero, call BitmapDecompression with a word-pointer third argument.
Else branch: call BitmapDecompression with null third argument (no word pointer) when the row width word is zero.

Guard: flags upper byte bit 0x20 set AND color type (this+0x116) != 3 selects palette transform: call sub_512ACC with buffer, rowbytes+1, source pointer this+0x138, and parameters this+0x144 and this+0x12C.
Guard: flags upper byte bit 0x04 set selects BitExpandDecompress on the row buffer.
Guard: PNG transform flags lower byte (this+0x60) bit 0x40 set selects PixelFormatConverter with parameters this+0x174 and this+0x178.
Guard: after PixelFormatConverter, rowbytes output (this+0xF4) must be non-zero. If zero, fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp with string 'png_do_dither returned rowbytes=0' (global:0x005AF450).
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x08 set selects sub_5126D9 background processing on the row buffer.
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x04 set selects BitPackingUnpacking on the row buffer.
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x01 set selects sub_5123E0 on the row buffer.
Guard: flags upper byte signed negative (bit 0x80 set, guard:0) selects PixelFormatExpansion with row buffer, rowbytes+1, bit depth this+0x11E, and width this+0x5C.
Guard: flags lower byte bit 0x10 set selects sub_5123B3 on the row buffer.
Function returns void; no value is produced.

unresolved: The unnamed callees sub_512E1A, sub_512ACC, sub_5126D9, sub_5123B3, sub_5123E0 implement individual PNG transform stages; their exact semantics are not independently confirmed.

functions.name: F_3DNowTransformationMatrixConstruction
functions.summary: Builds a 4x4 transformation matrix in the output __m64 buffer a1 from an angle parameter a2, using 3DNow!/MMX packed arithmetic. The angle is loaded into mm0, expanded into the packed-float domain by PackedFloatingPointMath, then distributed across the eight matrix slots together with 3DNow! identity/homogeneous constants: a 1.0f identity element at a1[0], zero rows, the angle and its high-dword/negated copies at a1[2]-a1[5], and a {1.0, 1.0} homogeneous row at a1[7]. All eight slots are written once; the function returns the output pointer.

Write the 1.0f identity element (1065353216) into matrix slot a1[0]; the value is sourced from the 3DNow! identity constant global (0x005AF9C0).
Zero matrix slot a1[1] (row 0 columns 2-3).
Write the dword pair {0, low32(angle)} into matrix slot a1[2].
Write the shifted angle copy v4 into matrix slot a1[3].
Write the dword pair {0, low32(pxor(v4, 0x80000000))} (negated shifted angle) into matrix slot a1[4].
Write the dword pair {low32(angle), 0} into matrix slot a1[5].
Zero matrix slot a1[6].
Write the homogeneous {1.0, 1.0} row (0x3F80000000000000) into matrix slot a1[7]; the value is sourced from the matrix-constants global (0x005AF9C8).
Emit the MMX/3DNow! state reset (_m_femms) and return the constructed matrix pointer a1.
